reviews.text: Excellent and peace of mind for your furry companions.TOP
Always top.
My lifelong reference

We handed over a swift that couldn't fly. The doctor examined it carefully and said he'd keep it for a couple of days before releasing it back into the wild. All this was free of charge because the clinic is also a wildlife rescue center.

Fully satisfied for over 20 years... Dr. Umberto is extraordinary.
For me, #1 in the world
Professionalism

Dr. Cara is a superb veterinarian from another era. Professional, knowledgeable, direct, friendly, and honest! All his staff are always attentive and follow his pace and method. And finally, the place where the doctor works is particularly beautiful and welcoming.

Excellent clinic.

Highly qualified doctor and assistants.
Hi, Doctor Cara saved my Maltese from a bad infection that no other vet was able to cure, I will always thank him for the rest of my life 🙏🏻❤️ …

If Dr. Cara agreed, I could entrust him with the care of my entire family, as well as my two dogs. A tireless and highly skilled professional, never hawkish and always available. I've had the pleasure of knowing him for years, and what has always fascinated me is the fact that he never flaunted his professionalism and was always ready to explain to us in simple and understandable terms everything he did for our dogs. A true institution. Clearly, someone like him also has a knack for choosing the right people to work with him: from his talented assistants to the legendary Valeria. Always and only the Appia Antica Veterinary Clinic.

Dr. Cara, in addition to being an impeccable and tireless professional (he saved the life of one of our French bulldogs who was in very serious condition, a truly complicated and uncommon situation), also has rare empathy and understanding for owners.
I highly recommend him.
Dr. Cara's love, expertise, and experience, along with a highly professional team, are what give you peace of mind when your friend, whoever they are, is having a problem.

I've been going to Dr. Cara for years, and besides his incredible love for animals, he's also competent and incredibly good. My dog ​​is 5 years old, and I've always taken him to him. He also saved my dad's dog years ago (other doctors had told us the only solution was to have him put down). Guess what? He lived another 3 years.

A simply appalling experience. From the rudeness and incompetence of the receptionist to the filthiness of the examination rooms, from the blood sampling on the floor (which failed because the blood gas machine wasn't working) to the rudeness and gruffness of the clinic owner, to the indelicacy of the oncologist in ruling that the dog will die in 8-12 months (the same oncologist at another clinic diagnosed her with a mast cell tumor in her leg three years ago, which should have killed me within a year).

In short, a full-color 3D nightmare.

A place I don't want to see again, not even in a nightmare.
The staff and veterinarian were delightful. He (the veterinarian, Dr. Cara) is passionate and knowledgeable about a variety of animals, including wild ones, which impressed me. Well done.

A veterinarian who has been frequented by the entire extended family for well over twenty years, I am now part of the second generation to blindly trust the experience and intuition of Dr. Cara and his staff.
He excels in caring for and understanding animals, in providing intensive, if not routine, care, and in informing and training their owners.
Both as an individual and a professional, he is a friendly face and a trustworthy person, and someone who knows his stuff (in my opinion) better than anyone in Rome.

To make matters worse, my dog ​​had a foxtail grass embedded in his paw; lazy, I took him to a closer clinic, which over the course of two months, about a dozen visits, and six different vets (who painfully dug into the wound without success and recommended a surgical approach once they gave up).
Nothing was gained, except the realization that; In 15 seconds, counted before my very eyes, Mr. Cara extracted the foxtail with a smile and instructed me on how I should help the dog in his recovery.

Waiting times are often long, but commitments can be made up for, but health cannot.

I strongly believe it's one of the best veterinary clinics in Rome.
Dr. Cara is a veterinarian from another era.
He carries out his profession daily with dedication and love for animals.
My Byron has been treated by him for five years, and I wouldn't entrust him to anyone else.
Dr. Cara has a positive attitude and is open to discussion, always sharing suggestions.
Sometimes the doctor is a bit harsh with owners, but if you listen, he's always right.
He's not a veterinarian who works for money, but purely out of passion, which is very rare these days.
Valeria manages the clinic's daily schedule with great professionalism, and beyond.
I highly recommend the Appia Antica Veterinary Clinic.

Amazing is an understatement; super professional and incredibly animal-loving.
Dr. Cara and his team operated on my dog, removing a tumor from his toe, and they are treating him and monitoring him constantly. I'll never be without them again.

I'd give Dr. Cara 100 stars!!!
He saved my cat Zeno, who was suffering from an ongoing abdominal hemorrhage, with composure and expertise.
By intervening at the right time and suspending the treatment, putting him on oxygen,
before it was too late; he saved his life!
Zeno has lung cancer, but to date, Dr. Cara has given me 10 more wonderful months together.
Thank you, doctor, and thank you to your wonderful assistants!!
Care and expertise. Dr. Cara and his staff are always kind and knowledgeable. A true guarantee for our animal friends.
Good and polite... they love their job
We have 2 dogs and 3 cats followed by Dr. Cara...and I wouldn't change anything in the veterinary world for how satisfied we are...a true professional who loves animals

An extraordinary location surrounded by greenery, free parking, and the veterinarians are extremely professional, attentive, and fast.
I recommend it to anyone who cares about their pet.
